name: The Absent Minded Prospector
summary: In southern Darkshore, hostile stone golems overrun a dig site, and Archaeologist Hollee seeks help in Auberdine. She fears for Prospector Remtravel, her senior colleague, whose research often blinds him to mortal danger.

sections.title: A Perilous Dig
sections.body: Archaeologist Hollee came across the sea with the Explorers' League. Master Greywhisker sent her to apprentice under Prospector Remtravel, whose discoveries had made him renowned in Ironforge's academic circles. The League sent them to study ancient ruins along Darkshore's untamed coast. As they dug through what seemed to be the remains of a great civilization, violent stone golems burst from the earth and overran the site.

sections.title: Oblivious to Doom
sections.body: In panic, Hollee fled through the night to Auberdine, the night elf port, to seek help. Remtravel barely noticed the danger. Absorbed in his relics, the elderly prospector stayed among the rubble as lumbering constructs surrounded his camp. South of Auberdine, anyone who reaches him finds him grumbling about missing stone brushes and misplaced fossils.

faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel is a celebrated dwarven researcher with the Explorers' League of Ironforge. His discoveries made him famous in dwarven academic circles, but valuable relics can leave him blind to danger nearby.

faq.q: Why is Archaeologist Hollee in Auberdine?
faq.answer: Master Greywhisker assigned Hollee to assist Remtravel. When dangerous golems rose at their dig site, she fled north in panic to Auberdine to seek help with a rescue.

faq.q: What were the dwarves excavating in Darkshore?
faq.answer: The dwarves were excavating what seemed to be the remains of a great ancient civilization beneath Darkshore. Before golems overran the site, Remtravel had uncovered a mysterious fossil and stone artifacts.

faq.q: Where can Prospector Remtravel be found?
faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel is at the excavation site in southern Darkshore, among ancient ruins south of Auberdine. Dangerous golems surround his camp as he searches for his stone brush and fossil.

faq.q: Who sent this expedition to Darkshore?
faq.answer: The Explorers' League sent the expedition from Ironforge under Master Greywhisker's orders. Greywhisker assigned Hollee to apprentice under Remtravel and study Darkshore's ancient ruins.
Yes. Hostile golems prowl the ruins around Remtravel, but he is blind to the danger. He is focused on cataloging his findings and wonders where his tools and assistant have gone.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see Remtravel's obsessive curiosity at work: he risks life and limb over an uncatalogued fossil.
As an Alliance traveler, you see Ironforge researchers studying the unfamiliar ancient lands of their night elf allies in Kalimdor.
